2608.03659.title: How Closely Do LLM Reviews Align with Human Peer Review?
2608.03659.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate scientific reviews, yet existing evaluations rarely examine whether different providers align with both conference decisions and human reviewing priorities within the same controlled setting. We compare reviews from OpenAI GPT-5.4, Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 with human reviews and final decisions for 300 topic-matched ICLR 2026 submissions, equally divided among oral, poster, and rejected papers. Each model reviewed every paper using identical instructions and rating scales after decision information was removed. Our study contributes a cross-provider analysis of three complementary dimensions: alignment with broad and fine-grained decision categories, differences in recommendation-scale usage, and thematic agreement in identified weaknesses. All three LLMs distinguished accepted from rejected papers, but none reproduced the oral versus poster distinction present in human ratings. Scoring patterns were provider-specific: Gemini assigned systematically higher ratings, while OpenAI and Claude were closer to humans for rejected and poster papers but more critical of oral papers. Human and LLM reviews also differed in emphasis, with LLMs more frequently identifying missing baseline comparisons and humans more often raising computational-efficiency concerns. These results show that broad decision alignment does not imply agreement with finer human judgments or reviewing priorities.
2608.03659.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地用於生成科學評審，但現有的評估很少檢查不同提供者是否在相同的控制環境中與會議決策和人類評審優先事項保持一致。我們比較了來自 OpenAI GPT-5.4、Google Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 和 Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 的評審，並將其與 300 篇主題匹配的 ICLR 2026 提交的人工評審和最終決策進行比較，這些提交均等地分為口頭、海報和被拒絕的論文。每個模型在刪除決策信息後，使用相同的指示和評分標準對每篇論文進行評審。我們的研究提供了三個互補維度的跨提供者分析：與廣泛和細緻決策類別的一致性、推薦尺度使用的差異，以及在識別弱點方面的主題一致性。所有三個 LLM 都能區分被接受和被拒絕的論文，但沒有一個重現人類評分中存在的口頭與海報的區別。評分模式是提供者特定的：Gemini 系統性地給予更高的評分，而 OpenAI 和 Claude 在被拒絕和海報論文上更接近人類，但對口頭論文則更為苛刻。人類和 LLM 的評審在重點上也有所不同，LLM 更頻繁地識別缺失的基準比較，而人類則更常提出計算效率的擔憂。這些結果顯示，廣泛的決策一致性並不意味著與更細緻的人類判斷或評審優先事項達成一致。
